limitations: Binance listing evidence is not evidence of historical listing or executable prices on Bitso.
USDT is not USD. Official AVAXUSDT prices are retained as availability evidence, not inserted into the USD research panel.
The announcement and archive establish a verified reference market; they do not prove that no other spot or IOU market existed earlier.
The two July observations remain unverified for the selected spot-availability policy, not proven false or classified as IOUs.
The first daily candle open at 00:00 UTC labels a time bucket; trading begins at 06:30 UTC. Its close is only available at the end of that day.
Archive last-modified is in 2021, so this is historical event evidence, not a dataset proven obtainable at every historical decision time.
Binance documents that historical archives can be revised; pin the verified archive/checksum/CSV bytes and do not refresh them silently.
The original research prices after the cutoff and other assets retain their existing provenance limitations.
Eligibility must still use 250 observed daily closes and causal signals; no history is fabricated before availability.
purpose: availability evidence only; no strategy performance computed
